about: PreToolUse inputs recorded from Claude Code 2.1.325 on 2026-11-22 (a non-interactive session whose settings added one hook that wrote its stdin to a file): the main thread ran one Bash command, then a general-purpose subagent ran one. Keys and their order are as recorded; values that name a machine, a session or an id are placeholders the tests fill in. U-SK1: agent_id and agent_type appear only on the subagent call.
